translationRepairs: On jisi day of the sixth month, because he administered Xi Six Divisions great king affairs Huilibu was made great king of that division; acting associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; hunting-grounds director Saba, for merit against Zubu, was promoted Defender of the State grand general.

On jisi day of the sixth month, because he administered Xi Six Divisions great king affairs Huilibu was made great king of that division; acting associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Han mobile palace deployment director; hunting-grounds director Saba, for merit against Zubu, was promoted Defender of the State grand general.
Source 漢人行宮都部署 names the Han mobile-palace office; idiomatic Khitan is a factual mistranslation of 漢人.

Sixth month, on jisi day, because he administered Xi Six Divisions great king affairs Huilibu was made great king of that division; acting associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; hunting-grounds director Saba, for merit against Zubu, was promoted Defender of the State grand general.

Sixth month, on jisi day, because he administered Xi Six Divisions great king affairs Huilibu was made great king of that division; acting associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Han mobile palace deployment director; hunting-grounds director Saba, for merit against Zubu, was promoted Defender of the State grand general.
Literal likewise renders 漢人行宮都部署 as Khitan; Han restores the Chinese designation.
On guichou day the court hunted at Sha Ridge.
On guimao day the court hunted at Sha Ridge.
Day graph 癸卯 is guimao; guichou would be 癸丑, so the idiomatic day name is wrong.
On guichou day hunted at Sha Ridge.
On guimao day hunted at Sha Ridge.
Literal also misreads 癸卯 as guichou; guimao matches the sexagenary day.
On jiayin day the eight divisions of Poli came to submit and presented local goods.
On guichou day the eight divisions of Poli came to submit and presented local goods.
Day graph 癸丑 is guichou; jiayin would be 甲寅, so the idiomatic day name is wrong.
On jiayin day the eight divisions of Poli came to submit and presented local goods.
On guichou day the eight divisions of Poli came to submit and presented local goods.
Literal likewise misreads 癸丑 as jiayin; guichou is the correct reading.
On yimao day Wotela memorialized victory over Mogusi.
On jiayin day Wotela memorialized victory over Mogusi.
Day graph 甲寅 is jiayin; yimao would be 乙卯, so the idiomatic day name is wrong.
On yimao day Wotela memorialized victory over Mogusi.
On jiayin day Wotela memorialized victory over Mogusi.
Literal likewise misreads 甲寅 as yimao; jiayin matches the Chinese day.
On guiwei day associate administrator of affairs Wang Shiru was made associate privy commissioner; Khitan mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan associate administrator of affairs.
On guiwei day associate administrator of affairs Wang Shiru was made associate privy commissioner; Han mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan associate administrator of affairs.
Prior office title is 漢人行宮都部署; idiomatic Khitan invents 契丹 against the Chinese.
On guiwei day associate administrator of affairs Wang Shiru was made associate privy commissioner; Khitan mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan associate administrator of affairs.
On guiwei day associate administrator of affairs Wang Shiru was made associate privy commissioner; Han mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan associate administrator of affairs.
Literal repeats the same Khitan error for 漢人行宮都部署; Han is required.
On guihai day Xiao Tabuye was made Southern Court chancellor; Yelü Dabeinu hall front inspector-general.
On guihai day Xiao Tabuye was made Northern Court chancellor; Yelü Dabeinu hall front inspector-general.
Appointment is 北府宰相 (Northern Court chancellor); Southern would be 南府, as in the preceding retirement notice.
On guihai day Xiao Tabuye was made Southern Court chancellor; Yelü Dabeinu hall front inspector-general.
On guihai day Xiao Tabuye was made Northern Court chancellor; Yelü Dabeinu hall front inspector-general.
Literal likewise turns 北府宰相 into Southern Court chancellor; Northern restores the office.
On dingchou day Wuding Army military commissioner Liang Yuan was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
On dingchou day Wuding Army military commissioner Liang Yuan was made Han mobile palace deployment director.
Office is 漢人行宮都部署; idiomatic Khitan contradicts 漢人.
On dingchou day Wuding Army military commissioner Liang Yuan was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
On dingchou day Wuding Army military commissioner Liang Yuan was made Han mobile palace deployment director.
Literal has the same Khitan mistranslation of 漢人行宮都部署; Han is correct.
In the fifth year, on yimao day of the first spring month the court went to Yuer Marsh.
In the fifth year, on yisi day of the first spring month the court went to Yuer Marsh.
Day graph 乙巳 is yisi; yimao would be 乙卯, so the idiomatic day name is wrong.
In the fifth year, spring, first month, on yimao day, went to Yuer Marsh.
In the fifth year, spring, first month, on yisi day, went to Yuer Marsh.
Literal likewise misreads 乙巳 as yimao; yisi matches the Chinese day.

On jiazi day of the twelfth month associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; Khitan mobile palace deployment director Liang Yuan Liaoxing Army military commissioner.

On jiazi day of the twelfth month associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Han mobile palace deployment director; Han mobile palace deployment director Liang Yuan was made Liaoxing Army military commissioner.
Both offices are 漢人行宮都部署, and 為 marks Liang Yuan's transfer; Han plus was made corrects the Khitan error and completes the appointment verb.

Twelfth month, on jiazi day associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; Khitan mobile palace deployment director Liang Yuan Liaoxing Army military commissioner.

Twelfth month, on jiazi day associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Han mobile palace deployment director; Han mobile palace deployment director Liang Yuan was made Liaoxing Army military commissioner.
Literal likewise needs Han for both 漢人行宮都部署 titles and was made for 為 before Liang Yuan's new post.
On renwu day retired grand preceptor Tukaiqi was made Xi Six Divisions great king.
On renwu day retired grand preceptor Tukai was raised to Xi Six Divisions great king.
Person is 禿開; 起為 is the appointment formula, so Tukaiqi wrongly merges 起 into the name.
On renwu day retired grand preceptor Tukaiqi was made Xi Six Divisions great king.
On renwu day retired grand preceptor Tukai was raised to Xi Six Divisions great king.
Literal likewise treats 起為 as part of the name; Tukai with raised to matches 禿開起為.
On yiyou day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan died.
On yiyou day Han mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan died.
Death notice titles him 漢人行宮都部署; idiomatic Khitan is unsupported.
On yiyou day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan died.
On yiyou day Han mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan died.
Literal repeats Khitan for 漢人行宮都部署; Han restores the office name.
On yiwei day Eastern Capital regent Helu Saogu was made tiyin; Southern Court commissioner of the palace Xiao Changge Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
On yiwei day Eastern Capital regent Helu Saogu was made tiyin; Southern Court commissioner of the palace Xiao Changge Han mobile palace deployment director.
Xiao Changge is appointed 漢人行宮都部署; idiomatic Khitan misstates the office.
On yiwei day Eastern Capital regent Helu Saogu was made tiyin; Southern Court commissioner of the palace Xiao Changge Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
On yiwei day Eastern Capital regent Helu Saogu was made tiyin; Southern Court commissioner of the palace Xiao Changge Han mobile palace deployment director.
Literal likewise replaces 漢人 with Khitan; Han is required by the Chinese title.

On renshen day of the eleventh month, because Tianshun Army commoner Tian Shirong's family had lived together three generations, an edict granted him office and ordered one son attendant in the Third-Rank Court.

On renshen day of the eleventh month, because Tiande Army commoner Tian Shirong's family had lived together three generations, an edict granted him office and ordered one son attendant in the Third-Rank Court.
Place-army name is 天德軍 (Tiande); Tianshun would require 天順.

Eleventh month, on renshen day, because Tianshun Army commoner Tian Shirong's family had lived together three generations, edict granted him office and ordered one son attendant in the Third-Rank Court.

Eleventh month, on renshen day, because Tiande Army commoner Tian Shirong's family had lived together three generations, edict granted him office and ordered one son attendant in the Third-Rank Court.
Literal likewise misreads 天德軍 as Tianshun; Tiande matches the graphs.
That year Goryeo king Yong's eldest son Hou was enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States.
That year Goryeo king Yong's eldest son Yu was enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States.
Personal name graph is 俁 (Yu); Hou is not supported by the Chinese.
That year Goryeo king Yong's eldest son Hou was enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States.
That year Goryeo king Yong's eldest son Yu was enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States.
Literal likewise mistranslates 俁 as Hou; Yu restores the name.
